title: This blender works well
text: This blender works well. Is it a bit quieter than a regular blender.  The different speeds work well for different items.  I did have a slight leaking problem but opened it and realigned the bottom.  It works great now.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach SoundShield 5-Speed Blender, 950 Watts, Ice Crush and Clean Programs, 52oz Glass + Portable Jars, Blends Food, Shakes and Smoothies (53602)
features: Bring the versatility, power and quiet of Restaurant blenders to your own countertop. 950W of power, 5 speed controls with one-touch programs smoothie, ice crush and clean, lets you blend up just about anything. Easily switch between the 52 oz. Glass jar and the travel jar - the stainless steel blades fit both with the twist of the collar. Easily Fits under a cabinet. Bpa free.

Mix, blend, puree with MultiBlend technology. Mix up frozen margaritas, blend hummus to your preferred smoothness, or puree a fresh sauce to top the main event of a meal. The glass jar is designed to push food towards the blades. A domed lid gives food space to fold back down into the blades, and a sensor in the motor maintains the speed.

Balanced, buffered sound. The blender motor has Smart engineering elements, like muffled chambers, and design features including a two-piece shield that reduces the sound of hard ice and frozen ingredients being blended. This blender science - as we like to call it - shifts the frequency of sound from harsh to hushed.

Drip-free pour, dishwasher-safe parts. The 52 oz. Jar’s lid features a hatch-style pour spout that’s drip-free and can also double to stream in oils and other ingredients during blending. All lids, Jars and blades are dishwasher-safe.

Power of the pros with a 3-year. The sound shield blenders feature Hamilton beach’s award-winning, commercial-level engineering in a blender made for your home. It includes a 3-year limited and access to a team of employees dedicated to customer support, located in our U. S. Headquarters.
description: Hamilton Beach blenders are known worldwide for making smooth and delicious blended drinks. Over the years, people have relied on the Hamilton Beach blender for perfect icy drinks, shakes, smoothies, and the innovation that this historic brand is famous for. Hinged 2-Piece sound shield offers noise reduction.
